reason: Salla Shipping & Fulfillment APIs (https://docs.salla.dev/ship-fulfillment-apis/getting-started, opened 2026-09-25) let a Shipping or Order-Fulfilment APP registered in the Salla Partners portal manage a Salla MERCHANT store's shipments and orders under per-store OAuth; the Merchant API likewise manages a merchant's own store. Salla is a store platform, not a supplier: there is no supplier catalogue to search or order to place with a supplier, so this category's verbs have no counterpart; an adapter belongs with the sales channels.
